💰 Bidding Rules • Minimum bid is the listed starting bid price • Bid increments: $1 minimum • To bid, simply reply to the item’s comment thread with your bid • If outbid, you may re-bid any time before auction closes • Auction ends at the listed time
🎶 Multi-Win Discount • If you win 5 or more games, you’ll receive a 5% discount on all your winning bids! • Discount applies to the games only (not the shipping fee) • A thank-you bonus for bundle buyers!
🆕 Item Condition • To the best of my knowledge, all games are complete and condition is as described. • The used games are secondhand but come from a reputable company
📓 Other Notes • Questions welcome—feel free to send me a GeekMail • Happy bidding • Check back during the week as I may add more games to the auction.

This is a tale from a little while ago. Once upon a time, there was a girl who loved books very much. She went to her school library almost every day to borrow books, so everyone called her a “bookworm.” But one day, she suddenly and mysteriously disappeared. No one knew where she went, and rumors spread through the school that she had been spirited away. Strangely, however, the book she had borrowed at that time was found returned to the library’s shelves.
–Rules– Players take turns flipping over books laid out in a row, starting from one end. (This action is called “borrowing a book.”) The player who happens to borrow the book whose checkout record says “Bookworm” becomes the loser of the game. Use the various effects that the books possess, observe your opponent carefully, and aim for victory!

🎄 In Santa’s workshop, you must fulfill a wish list by exchanging, passing, or even stealing cards. Overview You are one of the helpers at Santa’s workshop and have been assigned to fulfill the wishlist of two children by exchanging, passing, or even stealing cards from other players. Be the first to complete both of your assignments and you win!
Components The North Pole contains 18 poker sized cards, that include into two types of cards: Assignment cards (4) and Present Cards (14). Assignment cards show your assigned wishlists, with one on each side. Each wish list has 3 items, Present cards have two parts: the present associated with a wishlist and a power to use during play.
Game Play: Draw cards from the draw or discard pile until you have 2 cards in your hand. Do one of the following: Play a card and resolve its power. Discard a card and draw a card from the draw pile. Pass and take no action. Check for completion of your assignment. If complete do the following: Reveal your present cards If you have the gift card, discard it. Return any remaining cards to your hand.

2018 version Awesome, abstract, tile-laying game - based around the powers of 2. Players take turns placing tiles by matching the symbols on the four corners of the tiles. Each time a tile is placed, tokens are placed on the newly placed tile and adjacent tiles. Tiles occupied by a player's tokens become their territory. In the end, player with the highest total score from their occupied tiles wins.
This puzzle game, titled “Heúrēkaⁿ”, involves strategic placement of tiles where the goal is to match numbers at the corners to score points. It’s designed to be both educational, by teaching players about powers of 2, and entertaining, suitable for both solo and multiplayer modes. The gameplay stimulates both logical thinking and creative problem-solving, making it a comprehensive brain exercise.
Get points by matching the numbers at the four corners of the tiles! You’ll naturally learn powers of 2 while playing! It’s a brain exercise that uses both your left and right hemispheres! Try to capture as much territory as possible on a 6×6 board while cornering your opponent! Play competitively or Enjoy the math puzzle to your heart’s content if you’re playing solo!
This is the first edition of the game (Copyright 2012-2018).
